project.name: npc_engine
project.overview:
NPC Engine v1.3 preserves all v1.0 runtime behavior (dialogue, gossip, events, scheduler) and all v1.2 graph-edit capabilities, corrected and extended.
Core improvements over v1.2: 1. All API routes versioned under /v1/* 2. Schema extensibility via game_schema.yaml (loaded at startup) 3. Soft-delete for characters (is_active flag) 4. Typed PATCH bodies — no raw dict crossing module boundaries 5. Correct edge DELETE semantics — IDs in path, no request body 6. graph_admin scope is a strict superset of graph_write 7. Embedding invalidation is self-healing (timestamp reconciliation) 8. All edge writes enforce referential integrity inside the Cypher transaction 9. Enum values are hardcoded base Literals + schema-declared extensions 10. Atomic character move endpoint 11. GET routes for all graph resources 12. Async reindex (202 Accepted + job polling) 13. Admin audit log read endpoint

key.description: Absolute path to game_schema.yaml; service fails to start if missing

rulebook.rule: All graph writes are transactionally atomic.
No route issues direct Cypher; routes delegate to services and writers.
All Cypher uses parameters; no string interpolation with user input.
Dialogue-driven relation updates use dialogue (bounded) path only.
Absolute relation writes are admin-route-only and audited.
Hard deletes must cascade in one transaction and return impact metadata.
Embedding invalidation runs after successful commit for affected IDs. Reconciler self-heals stale entries.
Every mutation includes metadata: request_id (audit only), actor_id, reason.
Soft-deleted characters (is_active=false) are excluded from ALL engine queries: gossip, event seeding, dialogue context, knowledge propagation.
graph_admin scope implicitly grants all graph_write permissions (admin ⊃ write).
Game-event relation deltas (POST /v1/graph/admin/relations/delta) are unbounded input, clamped to [0,100]. Clamped fields are logged and returned in response meta.
Edge deletion endpoints use path parameters only — no request body. Pattern: DELETE /v1/graph/edges/{type}/{src}/{dst}.
PATCH bodies accept only typed models (CharacterPatchBody etc.). Immutable fields are absent from the model shape — a 409 is returned if a field is set that the model does not allow.
POST /v1/graph/characters/{id}/move is atomic: deletes old LOCATED_AT, creates new LOCATED_AT, and updates character.current_location_id in a single transaction.
Edge-creation Cypher enforces referential integrity via MATCH inside the write transaction. Empty result raises NodeNotFoundError. No pre-read existence check.
extension_fields in any request body are validated at runtime against the loaded GameSchema by graph_edit_validator. Unknown fields return 422.
WorldState PATCH uses full-replace semantics for faction_standings and active_conditions. Partial merge is not supported.
POST /v1/graph/admin/reindex always returns 202 Accepted with a job_id. Status is polled via GET /v1/graph/admin/reindex/{job_id}.
